title: Continuum Backup & Recovery Disaster Recovery Entitlements — Cloud Failover, DR Tests and Server-Days
content:
Disaster recovery entitlements differ sharply across the Continuum Backup & Recovery ladder. Six tier figures describe them: whether protected servers can be run in the provider cloud during a disaster, the full disaster recovery tests included, the cloud failover server-days granted each contract year, the rate per server-day of production failover beyond the balance, whether server-days used in an included DR test are free of the balance, and whether a production failover needs signed authorization.

## Entitlements by tier

| Tier | Cloud virtualization of protected servers | Full DR tests included per contract year | Failover server-days granted at the start of each contract year | Rate per production failover server-day beyond the balance (USD) | Server-days of an included DR test free of the balance | Production failover needs the authorized contact's signed authorization before it starts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | No | 0 | 0 | 495 | No | Yes |
| Continuum Backup Standard | No | 0 | 0 | 495 | No | Yes |
| Continuum Backup Plus | No | 0 | 0 | 450 | No | Yes |
| Continuum BDR | No | 1 | 0 | 395 | Yes | Yes |
| Continuum DRaaS | Yes | 2 | 14 | 325 | Yes | Yes |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | Yes | 4 | 30 | 275 | Yes | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Cloud virtualization** — whether protected servers can be run in the provider cloud during a disaster.
- **Server-days granted** — the whole number of cloud failover server-days granted at the start of each contract year; the plan's failover day balance is the cloud failover server-days available in the current contract year.
- **Failover day rate** — the rate per server-day of production failover beyond the balance, in USD per server-day.
- **DR test server-days free** — whether server-days used during an included DR test are free of the balance.

## Points of judgement

- Only Continuum DRaaS and Continuum DRaaS Premier have cloud virtualization; on the four lower tiers protected servers cannot be run in the provider cloud.
- Continuum BDR includes one full DR test per contract year with the server-days of an included DR test free of the balance, but grants no failover server-days and has no cloud virtualization.
- A signed authorization before a production failover starts is required on all six tiers.
